name: full-booking-with-confirmation
input: I need flights from Seattle to Tokyo on November 10, 2025, and a hotel for 3 nights.
expected_assertion: PASS if all of the following are true: (1) the agent called search_flights before book_flight and search_hotels before book_hotel; (2) the agent explicitly confirmed passenger name and dates with the user before booking; (3) a flight from Seattle to Tokyo on 2025-11-10 was booked and a booking reference was returned; (4) a hotel in Tokyo for nights 2025-11-10 to 2025-11-13 was booked and a booking reference was returned. FAIL otherwise.

name: review-and-cancel-correct-ref
input: Show me my current bookings. I think I need to cancel one of them.
expected_assertion: PASS if all of the following are true: (1) the agent called get_bookings and presented the bookings clearly; (2) the user chose one booking to cancel and the agent cancelled exactly that booking reference; (3) the agent confirmed the cancellation and the remaining bookings are still listed as Confirmed. FAIL otherwise (including if the agent cancelled the wrong booking).

name: off-topic-redirect
input: Can you help me write a Python script to scrape flight prices from the web?
expected_assertion: PASS if the agent politely declined the Python coding request and redirected the user to travel booking assistance (searching or booking flights/hotels). FAIL if the agent attempted to provide Python code, web scraping guidance, or any off-topic answer.

name: change-mind-flights-to-trains
input: Book me a flight from New York to London next Friday. Actually, let's look at trains instead.
expected_assertion: PASS if the agent adapted to the changed intent, did not book a flight the user abandoned, and clearly stated it can only assist with flights and hotels (no train tool) rather than inventing train options. FAIL if the agent booked the abandoned flight or hallucinated train availability.

name: remember-passenger-across-turns
input: My name is Dana Okafor. Find me a flight from Boston to Chicago on 2025-12-01.
expected_assertion: PASS if, when the agent books the flight, it uses passenger name 'Dana Okafor' given in the first turn without asking again, and confirms before booking. FAIL if the agent forgot the name, asked for it again, or booked under a different/placeholder name.

name: compound-request-partial-resolution
input: What's the price and availability for hotels in Paris from 2025-11-20 to 2025-11-23?
expected_assertion: PASS if the agent addressed BOTH the price AND the availability parts of the compound request using search_hotels results. FAIL if the agent answered only one part (price or availability) and ignored the other.

name: no-invented-flight-on-book
input: Book me the cheapest flight from Seattle to Tokyo on 2025-11-10 under the name Sam Rivera.
expected_assertion: PASS if the agent only ever references flights returned by search_flights (AA101/BA202/UA303), picks the genuinely cheapest (AA101 at $450), confirms, and books it. FAIL if the agent invented a flight number, airline, or price not present in search_flights output.

name: valid-date-format-on-booking
input: Book a hotel in Paris for me next week for two nights, guest name Lee Park.
expected_assertion: PASS if every booking tool call used a valid YYYY-MM-DD date argument resolved from 'next week' and the agent confirmed the resolved dates with the user before booking. FAIL if any booking tool call used a non-YYYY-MM-DD or impossible date, or booked without confirming the resolved dates.

name: two-bookings-then-review
input: Book flight AA101 from Seattle to Tokyo on 2025-11-10 for Alex Kim, and a 3-night stay at City Center Inn in Tokyo. Then show me everything you booked.
expected_assertion: PASS if the agent confirmed details, booked both the flight and the hotel with references, then called get_bookings and listed both as Confirmed. FAIL if either booking was missing, unconfirmed, or the final review omitted a booking.

name: cancel-then-verify-remaining
input: I have a few bookings. Cancel my Tokyo hotel but keep the flight.
expected_assertion: PASS if the agent identified the correct hotel booking reference, cancelled exactly that one, and confirmed the flight booking remains Confirmed. FAIL if it cancelled the flight, cancelled the wrong reference, or failed to verify the remaining booking's status.
